name: functional_revival

truth_table.reason: No counts, genotype assays or functional observations were supplied.
Reported colony growth and selected assays do not establish donor-dependent functional revival.

source.citation: Genome Revival Toolkit SPEC D12 and Appendix B3 (2026-10-16)
source.archive_note: Project files retained in repository history.
supports: Adopt a bounded conclusion; observations alone cannot certify functional revival.
does_not_support: Biological proof of revival, elimination, causality or record authenticity.

limits: Project interpretation boundary; not an experimentally established biological sufficiency rule.
